_comment: signal_modulation/05b_ampsweep (2026-09-09): CW amplitude sweep of the MIXING 4-source design-05 reservoir. Geometry from 05_spread_passive v3: 10-um slab (cell_y 14), four 2-um Ey strips at y=+-1.25,+-3.75 (pitch 2.5) — chosen because the passive map shows the beams interleaving within the 20-um crystal (2-um strip: FWHM 1.4->5.3 um; half-pitch crossed ~12 um in), so with gain ON the channels share/burn common inversion = real spatial nonlinearity, unlike the old 27.5-um/4-um layout whose beams never met (I(y) shapes collapsed under normalisation). Pump 100, no rate_32, gpumeep, settled window 3000-6000 (validated on the old geometry at drive 20; per-level pop traces confirm in-window flatness here too). All 4 strips at the SAME level per run; ladder passed to scripts/slurm_sat4src_gpu_lips.sh. field_map (full-cell 2Ddft @1.064) kept per level: it shows the internal mixed pattern reshaping with drive — the direct visual of the nonlinearity. NEW FOLDER deliberately: level-named npz must not merge with 05_ampsweep's old-geometry results.

crystal._comment: Nd:YAG gain ON (design-05 model: emission+pump, no rate_32) over the 10-um slab. With 2-um strips at 2.5-um pitch the beams interleave INSIDE the crystal (passive v3 map), so saturation is shared between channels -> genuine cross-mixing.

snap_point._comment: output y-LINE time record (1Dsnap = line in y). The multi-strip output is y-dependent, so a single point misses the transverse profile; this records the whole output-guide y-line vs time. dt 20 (coarse on purpose) keeps storage modest for long/many runs — tune down toward the 1.064 carrier period (~1.06 t.u.) if you need the field phase rather than the envelope.

source_4._comment: strip 4: 2 um wide at y=3.75 (pitch 2.5) — passive 4-strip overlap test

field_map._comment: full-cell |E|(x,y) at 1.064 over 300-600. Includes the source point — clip the colour scale when plotting (known full-domain-2Ddft gotcha).

source_1._comment: strip 1: 2 um wide at y=-3.75 (pitch 2.5) — passive 4-strip overlap test

source_2._comment: strip 2: 2 um wide at y=-1.25 (pitch 2.5) — passive 4-strip overlap test

source_3._comment: strip 3: 2 um wide at y=1.25 (pitch 2.5) — passive 4-strip overlap test

source_pump._comment: 808 nm CW pump from above, Ez, whole 20-um crystal top edge. Amp 100 (the 'set pump so stationary comes quickly' knob, 2026-09-09): with no rate_32 the pump is the recharge and its rate sets how fast the inversion reaches steady state.

pop_monitor._comment: inversion vs time - THE key plot for this toy: N3 should be seen bleaching on each strong symbol and RECHARGING between them (tau_32 = 5000 t.u.), i.e. actually recovering within the run, which no prior design could show.
